messages:
zoe: Quick one - Nimbus wants to run 2 POCs in parallel and asks to pool credits and convert to a single commit if they sign within 90 days. Can we do stacking?
ben: We can if both POCs bill to the same billing account. Different legal entities = separate commits.
maria: Deal Desk: OK with consolidated commit but need explicit SOW mapping, CSV import, and a stacking cap (default 2). Exceptions require Deal Desk approval.
ben: Technical note - different models + instance types = different per-token economics. Quote should include model SKUs or multipliers.
revops-bot: RevOps requires CSV: BILLING_ENTITY,POC_TAG,START_TS,END_TS,CREDIT_CAP,CONSOLIDATE_COMMIT_ID. Upload via /deal-request and attach SOW.
zoe: Customer asks for "no charge during POC" and credits reserved for 90d. Ops preference is meter+credit so we keep telemetry.
maria: 90d window is acceptable. Terms to include: credits expire after 90d; non-transferable across billing entities; stacking limit = 2 active POCs per billing entity without approval.
ben: Add disclosure: shared infra (same project/endpoints) can create shared cache benefits and lower combined cost than sum of estimates.
legal-bot: Legal: credits must be timeboxed and auditable; applied to future invoices only; no cash refunds for committed fees.
zoe: I'll prepare SOW + CSV and open /deal-request. Thanks everyone.
